text: Good morning, Central New Jersey. The weather service has a Tornado Watch for parts of the area, so check it before you head out. Watch for a closure at NJ 73 northbound : Equipment malfunction (21.3 mi away). It's 61°F, Showers And Thunderstorms, up to 61°. Rain is likely around 3 PM, so bring an umbrella.
